_about: Single source of truth for every clinic fact the site may show. status: verified | candidate | missing. The build only renders a fact as a current assertion when status is 'verified'; candidate and missing facts render as a 'being confirmed' state. Change a status only with the named approver's sign-off and record the date.

_schema.status: verified = confirmed by an authoritative source AND approved for display; candidate = seen in public sources but unconfirmed or conflicting; missing = no reliable source yet.
_schema.last_checked: ISO date the sources were last checked.
_schema.approver: Who must approve before the fact can go live.
_schema.notes: Conflicts, caveats, and what is needed to verify.
